components.title: Mensagens
components.note: Native v1 user/assistant/tool-result codecs, exact or explicitly unknown timestamps, owner-assigned request/invocation identity and raw argument validation are implemented. Indexed entries, V5 conversion and durable storage remain NH03.

components.title: Streaming
components.note: Ordered bounded blocks, final replacement and terminal fencing are implemented. Awaitable session barriers and durable event envelopes remain NH05.

components.title: Catálogo e capacidades dos modelos
components.note: Baseline evidence characterizes NH00 only; the versioned canonical/session target remains open.

components.title: Adapter de provider
components.note: All four wire adapters accept native blocks and own preparation terminals. Per-model capabilities, aliases and authenticated qualification remain open.

components.title: Loop do agente
components.note: NH05: each chat run is owned by an AgentSession that persists its canonical branch and is observed through coalesced snapshots. Replaying canonical history to the model remains NH06.

components.title: Estado e barreiras
components.note: NH05: awaited message/usage barriers, typed persistence failure, durable command idempotency, phase/identity projection and closure of unfinished branches.

components.title: Filas e continuação
components.note: NH08: FIFO steering and follow-up queues with one/all modes, complete-list updates and stable IDs, saved before acknowledgement; drained items are committed as user messages; continueRun answers an open request or one queued selection.

components.title: Cancelamento
components.note: NH05: an abort settles only after the producer and its tools terminated and the end entry was written; the chat stays cancelling until then.

components.title: Armazenamento
components.note: NH03 supplies indexed checked entries, an independent active leaf, immutable artifact revisions and recovery metadata containers. Frozen V5 upgrades to additive V6; per-session conversion retains original bytes and historical unknowns. Detailed runtime barriers remain NH05; full active-path model replay remains NH06.

components.title: Árvore e navegação
components.note: NH09: alternatives, atomic navigation while settled, fork, clone, labels, rename, branch-aware artifact revisions and save actions, and usage over every branch versus the selected path. Open: branch summaries.

components.title: Projeção de contexto
components.note: NH06: replay projects each answered question's run branch (request, calls, results, answer) from the log, excludes audit-only replies, applies context edits and the newest permitted checkpoint, and keeps reads outside the current source authorization out of context.

components.title: System prompt e instruções
components.note: NH06: ordered system sections with Kurn's meeting-assistant instructions as a stable prefix and the document index as its own section; each run records its prompt as a patch on the previous run's and its declared tools with their delta. A document mutation inside a run is reflected from the next run on.

components.title: Compactação
components.note: NH06: durable summary checkpoints committed before use and reused on replay; no omission note stands in for a summary. Manual compaction and optional branch summaries remain open.

components.title: Retry e recuperação
components.note: NH07: the session is the one retry owner; transient failures before visible text are retried as new requests with bounded, cancellable backoff, failed attempts stay as audit data. Open: the agent transport does not carry Retry-After into its error yet.

components.title: Configuração e trust
components.note: NH04 captures immutable source IDs/parts/content revisions and rejects deleted sources. Durable authorization entries and source-aware replay remain NH05/NH06.

components.title: Credenciais
components.note: NH07: credentials are resolved for every request, compaction included; a removed key fails the next request. OAuth remains separate work.

components.title: Uso, cache e diagnóstico
components.note: NH07: input/output/reasoning/cache-read/cache-write counters with reasoning and cache counted once; unknown cost stays unknown and an unverifiable cost ceiling stops the run; the app passes its price table as the estimator.

components.title: Registro e pipeline
components.note: NH04 local bundled-tool profile: strict checked schema registry, transformed-argument policy revalidation, terminal progress fences, bounded independent reads and atomic local document receipts. No external extensions or result-replacement/termination hooks.

components.title: Ferramentas desktop e equivalentes locais
components.note: Kurn source/document equivalents retain Unicode-safe pagination and source selection. Local document mutations commit revisions and receipts before success; saved library documents remain independent.

components.title: Extensões
components.note: Outside the app-only profile: no external runtime, gateway or extension loader.

components.note: NH08: Steer/After this task actions, queued list with edit/remove, retry delay, compaction and confirmed-stop status in words, reading position kept. Open: a session-retained owner and model changes at request boundaries.

components.note: Local typed commands replace RPC: start with a durable command ID, abort, settle and retry settlement, observed through newest-only snapshots. Native export is required and pi interchange is a qualified subset.

acceptance.requirement: Segundo request recebe assistant e toolResult correlacionados
acceptance.note: Legacy evidence does not establish the full target criterion.

acceptance.requirement: Segundo é rejeitado ou enfileirado explicitamente na camada de sessão
acceptance.note: NH05: the session owner rejects a second prompt as busy from acceptance, before any store await; the chat refuses a send until its run settles. A repeated command is refused durably from the log. Queueing it instead is NH08.

acceptance.requirement: Replay altera só seção indicada; null remove
acceptance.note: NH06: a run's systemPatch changes only the sections it names; an explicit null removes one.

acceptance.requirement: Próxima request declara delta e conjunto efetivo correto
acceptance.note: NH06: each run-start records the declared tools and what was added or removed since the previous run.

acceptance.requirement: Mesmo conteúdo final sem caracteres corrompidos
acceptance.note: Indexed JSON fragments and Unicode native codecs are exercised; full transport/interchange qualification remains open.

acceptance.requirement: Índices mantêm texto/thinking/toolCall separados
acceptance.note: Native block indices preserve thinking/text/call separation and provider ordering through interleaved fragments; this verifies the in-process criterion, not durable session storage.

acceptance.requirement: End substitui reconstrução
acceptance.note: The authoritative final replaces draft blocks, text, calls and usage, including corrected/removed/reordered Responses items. Removed calls never execute.

acceptance.requirement: Mensagem final de erro e nenhum estado pendente eterno
acceptance.note: Preparation emits one typed failure before any start event and reaches normal app error handling. Persisted canonical error messages and session settlement remain NH03/NH05.

acceptance.requirement: Agent permanece ocupado até listener terminar
acceptance.note: NH05: the owner stays busy until the producer terminated and its terminal entry was saved, and its observation ends only then. There is no public listener API; the host awaits settlement.

acceptance.scenario: Dois tools paralelos, segundo termina primeiro
acceptance.requirement: UI segue conclusão; transcript segue ordem do assistant
acceptance.note: NH04 local app-only profile; native session ownership and recovery orchestration remain NH05.

acceptance.requirement: Nenhuma sobreposição de execução do lote
acceptance.note: NH04 local app-only profile; native session ownership and recovery orchestration remain NH05.

acceptance.requirement: Todas terminam antes da injeção; próxima request recebe steering
acceptance.note: NH08: every call of the batch finishes before steering is injected, and the next request carries it.

acceptance.requirement: Só entra quando scheduler esgota tools e steering
acceptance.note: NH08: a follow-up enters only when no tool call and no steering is left.

acceptance.requirement: Quantidade drenada correta em ambas as filas
acceptance.note: NH08: one and all modes drain the right number of items.

acceptance.requirement: Erro sem consumir pendências
acceptance.note: NH08: continuing an empty history, or a finished reply with nothing queued, fails before any request without consuming the queues.

acceptance.requirement: Uma seleção de fila, sem duplicar drain inicial
acceptance.note: NH08: continuing after a reply takes one queue selection; the run's own end drains the rest without taking any input twice.

acceptance.requirement: End não consulta filas; continue assegura uma request sem duplicar natural
acceptance.note: NH08: continuation ensures one request for an open history without a duplicate natural drain. Kurn has no end/continue hooks; a run's end consults the queues as part of its loop.

acceptance.requirement: Erro sem efeito, com execution_end
acceptance.note: NH04 local app-only profile; native session ownership and recovery orchestration remain NH05.

acceptance.scenario: argumentsError ou assistant length com calls
acceptance.requirement: argumentsError bloqueia aquela chamada; length bloqueia todas as chamadas da resposta
acceptance.note: Invalid raw arguments block that invocation while a valid sibling executes; length blocks every invocation, retains raw calls and adds synthetic errors without confirmation/effects. Durable audit restoration remains NH03/NH04, beyond this execution criterion.

acceptance.requirement: Não executa nem roda tool_result; resultado de erro completo
acceptance.note: NH04 local app-only profile; native session ownership and recovery orchestration remain NH05.

acceptance.note: NH04 local app-only profile; native session ownership and recovery orchestration remain NH05.

acceptance.requirement: Não entra no contexto ativo
acceptance.note: NH06: only the run that answered a question on the shown path is replayed; sibling branches (failed, stopped or for another question) never enter context.

acceptance.requirement: Fork antes de user com draft; clone inclui posição atual
acceptance.note: NH09: fork copies the path before the selected question into a new conversation and restores the question as a draft; clone copies the branch shown; the source keeps every branch.

acceptance.requirement: Altera futuro contexto; raw/UI/custo intactos
acceptance.note: NH06: context edits apply to replay only; the log, the shown conversation and recorded usage are unchanged, and calls keep their results.

acceptance.requirement: Resumo + recente + checkpoint, sem toolResult órfão
acceptance.note: NH06: summary plus kept tail plus a durable checkpoint; the cut never separates a call from its result.

acceptance.requirement: Fronteiras corretas e sem perda de trecho que precisava resumir
acceptance.note: NH06: a second compaction updates the previous summary and the newest checkpoint covers everything the first did. Retain-none does not apply: the policy always keeps the newest cut point (keepRecentTokens >= 1).

acceptance.requirement: Nenhuma compaction fictícia nem retry indevido
acceptance.note: NH06: an unusable, failed or overflowing summary writes no checkpoint and no omission note; after an overflow the run fails with AgentContextReductionError instead of retrying.

acceptance.requirement: Falha persiste; edits após agent_end; retry depois de resumo salvo
acceptance.note: NH06: the failed attempt stays in the log as audit data, the checkpoint is saved before the single retry, and a checkpoint that cannot be saved stops the run before any request uses it.

acceptance.scenario: Retry transitório e cancelamento do delay
acceptance.requirement: Tentativas limitadas; abort não inicia outra
acceptance.note: NH07: attempts and total wait are bounded, Retry-After is honoured when the error carries it, and a cancel during the wait starts no new attempt.

acceptance.requirement: Sem dupla contagem
acceptance.note: NH07: reasoning is part of output and cache reads/writes part of input, each counted once in all four wire formats; unreported counts stay unknown when added.

acceptance.requirement: Desconhecido distinto de zero
acceptance.note: NH06: context usage is nil (unknown), never zero, before reported usage, after a compaction and when no input is reported; summary usage never sets it.

acceptance.requirement: Budget do modelo efetivo e validação de settings corretos
acceptance.note: NH06: thresholds, kept tail and summary output come from the effective model's own window and output limit; the 16k/20k defaults never apply to a small model. Kurn has no user compaction override setting.

acceptance.requirement: UI continua ocupada até agent_settled
acceptance.note: NH05: an output-limit retry keeps the run in retryWaiting until its request starts, and the chat stays busy (cancelling included) until the run settles. Bounded session retries across runs are NH07.

acceptance.requirement: clear antes de abort; draft recebe pendências
acceptance.note: NH08: a stop clears the queue before it aborts and hands pending input back to the composer; a reopened conversation hands back what a dead process left queued.

acceptance.requirement: Atualizações não roubam posição de leitura
acceptance.note: NH08: new turns scroll into view only while the reader is at the end or for their own question.

acceptance.note: NH05: a run writes on its own branch and never moves the selected leaf; a raced append is rebuilt on the new snapshot, a reset or reload fences the old run, and an unfinished branch is closed without moving the leaf.
